ownership_model.rationale: Existing thirdparty.bhom.data.structure.v1.Bar is Raven's native editable projection component. thirdparty.bhom.data.base.v1.BHoMSource is the shared handwritten provenance/source payload. Generated source-fidelity BHoM schema types must not collide with either or imply Motif ECS semantics.

Geometry_oM/Point.json.reason: Motif geometry remains canonical for 3D points.

Physical_oM/Elements/Floor.json.Location.reason: Slice one supports only Floor outer-boundary geometry through PlanarSurface.

Physical_oM/Elements/Floor.json.Construc.reason: Floor construction/material polymorphism is deferred and preserved through BHoMSource/source JSON.

Physical_oM/Elements/Floor.json.Openings.reason: Floor openings are deferred and preserved through BHoMSource/source JSON.

Physical_oM/Elements/Floor.json.Offset.reason: Floor offset editing is deferred and preserved through BHoMSource/source JSON.

Physical_oM/Elements/Floor.json.Fragment.reason: FragmentSet expansion is deferred and preserved through BHoMSource/source JSON.

Geometry_oM/PlanarSurface.json.ExternalB.reason: Floor slice supports only Polygon or closed Polyline external boundaries.

Geometry_oM/PlanarSurface.json.InternalB.reason: PlanarSurface internal boundaries are deferred and preserved through BHoMSource/source JSON.

Spatial_oM/ShapeProfiles/AngleProfile.js.reason: Raw BHoM profile Edges are source-preserved; Raven's native Curve2 projection is not inferred by this generator.

Spatial_oM/ShapeProfiles/BoxProfile.json.reason: Raw BHoM profile Edges are source-preserved; Raven's native Curve2 projection is not inferred by this generator.

Spatial_oM/ShapeProfiles/CircleProfile.j.reason: Raw BHoM profile Edges are source-preserved; Raven's native Curve2 projection is not inferred by this generator.

Spatial_oM/ShapeProfiles/RectangleProfil.reason: Raw BHoM profile Edges are source-preserved; Raven's native Curve2 projection is not inferred by this generator.

Spatial_oM/ShapeProfiles/TubeProfile.jso.reason: Raw BHoM profile Edges are source-preserved; Raven's native Curve2 projection is not inferred by this generator.

deferred_branches.name: Floor non-planar ISurface
deferred_branches.reason: Only BH.oM.Geometry.PlanarSurface is generated for Floor.Location; Extrusion, Loft, NurbsSurface, Pipe, and PolySurface are unsupported in this slice.

deferred_branches.name: Floor curved/NURBS boundaries
deferred_branches.reason: Only BH.oM.Geometry.Polygon and closed BH.oM.Geometry.Polyline external boundaries are editable; Arc, Circle, Ellipse, Line, NurbsCurve, PolyCurve, and BoundaryCurve remain source-preserved.

deferred_branches.name: Floor internal boundaries
deferred_branches.reason: PlanarSurface.InternalBoundaries are deferred and remain source-preserved through BHoMSource.

deferred_branches.name: Floor openings
deferred_branches.reason: Openings are deferred and remain source-preserved through BHoMSource.

deferred_branches.name: Floor construction/material polymorphism
deferred_branches.reason: Construction and material expansion are deferred and remain source-preserved through BHoMSource.

deferred_branches.name: Floor FragmentSet expansion
deferred_branches.reason: Fragments are not expanded by the source-schema generator in this slice.

deferred_branches.name: Bar Box hollow/radii projection
deferred_branches.reason: BoxProfile source DTO retains Thickness, OuterRadius, and InnerRadius, but hollow-section and radius behavior remain a Raven native-projection decision.

deferred_branches.name: Bar Angle root/toe radii projection
deferred_branches.reason: AngleProfile source DTO retains RootRadius and ToeRadius, but radius behavior remains a Raven native-projection decision.

deferred_branches.name: Bar unsupported profile types
deferred_branches.reason: Only RectangleProfile, CircleProfile, TubeProfile, BoxProfile, and AngleProfile are generated in this batch; Channel, Fabricated*, FreeForm, Generalised*, ISection, Kite, Tapered*, TSection, VoidedISection, and ZSection remain source-preserved.

deferred_branches.name: Bar raw profile Edges
deferred_branches.reason: Profile Edges remain repeated raw JSON values in generated DTOs and source payload; Curve2 projection is deferred.

BH.oM.Structure.Elements.Bar.supported_closure: Bar -> Node and BarFEAType; declared Bar profile companions -> RectangleProfile, CircleProfile, TubeProfile, BoxProfile, AngleProfile, and ShapeType.
BH.oM.Structure.Elements.Bar.projection_notes: SectionProperty remains source-preserved JSON because its interface is polymorphic. Projection into Motif ECS behavior is manual-only and must not be inferred by this generator.

BH.oM.Physical.Elements.Floor.supported_closure: Floor -> PlanarSurface -> Polygon or closed Polyline -> Point
BH.oM.Physical.Elements.Floor.projection_notes: Generated Floor has no Motif component ID and no Raven target in this migration. It remains a source-fidelity scaffold; construction, material, offset, fragments, CustomData, internal boundaries, and openings stay source-preserved through BHoMSource.
